---
title: "Tests and validation"
---

```bash
.venv/bin/python -m pytest            # all tests (about ten seconds)
.venv/bin/ruff check src tests
.venv/bin/mypy src
ONTHESIGNAL_E2E=1 .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_web_e2e.py   # browser tests
cd docs && QUARTO_PYTHON=../.venv/bin/python ../.venv/bin/quartodoc build \
        && QUARTO_PYTHON=../.venv/bin/python quarto render
```

| File | Content |
|---|---|
| `tests/test_core.py` | parameters, units, `Signal` operators, results, session |
| `tests/test_io.py` | miniSEED gap policies (V-15), text files (V-16), export |
| `tests/test_analysis.py` | noise, band limitation, LNM, sine fit, SINAD, ENOB, THD, SFDR, dynamic (V-01 to V-09, V-13) |
| `tests/test_measures.py` | crossings, frequency, period, delay, coherence, spectrogram (V-10 to V-12) |
| `tests/test_synthetic.py` | test signals: theoretical SINAD of an ideal quantized sine, amplitude options, harmonics, mains, noise color and seeds |
| `tests/test_cli.py` | console: Python input, `/` commands, forms, completion |
| `tests/test_scripts_reports.py` | script template, batches, standalone scripts, Quarto reports |
| `tests/test_acquisition.py` | SeedLink acquisition and real time with a fake client |
| `tests/test_ai.py` | assistant with a scripted fake provider, agent.md, `/init`, message conversions |
| `tests/test_web_core.py` | session events, result names, layouts of every analysis, results panel, decimation, console hooks (no NiceGUI needed) |
| `tests/test_web.py` | web interface: security middleware, chart data, shared state, Python terminal engine (skipped without the `[web]` extra) |
| `tests/test_web_e2e.py` | browser tests with Playwright and Google Chrome, opt-in: `pip install -e ".[e2e]"`, then `ONTHESIGNAL_E2E=1` |

Validation tests use synthetic signals whose answer is known analytically (white noise of known
σ, ideal quantization, sines with known harmonics and spurs, ramps with sub-sample delays) and
assert the tolerances of the specification (§19). The SeedLink and AI tests use fake clients,
so the suite needs no network.

When adding real reference records for non-regression, put them in `tests/data/` with the
expected values next to them.
